name: Katsura Kogorou
source:
A heroic warrior from Choshu who has strong ambitions. The Shinsen-gumi are constantly pursuing him, yet he stays in Kyoto to achieve his goals. For some reason he gets along well with Okubo, despite them being polar opposites. His cheerful nature hides a secret.

[Edited from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
